questions.q: The motion of the body moving along a circular path is an example of .
questions.solution:
The correct answer is accelerated motion.

Key Points

• The rate at which an object's velocity with respect to time changes is referred to as acceleration in mechanics.

• A body travelling in a circle at a constant speed is said to be moving at an accelerated rate since its motion is uniform in speed but not in velocity, which can be expressed in magnitude and direction as a vector quantity.

• The item is said to be accelerating when the magnitude remains constant but the direction shifts in a circular motion.

Additional Information

• Decelerated motion

• ​A moving item might slow down or come to a stop as a result of unbalanced forces, reducing its speed. For instance, when a ball is thrown upward, it experiences both the upward applied force and the downward gravitational force.

• Non-uniform motion

• ​No matter how long the time intervals are, non-uniform motion refers to movement in which the item does not go the same lengths in the same amount of time. The motion of the body is regarded as non-uniform motion whenever the velocity of the moving object changes at a different pace, throughout the course of the same time interval.

• Uniform motion

• This kind of motion is described as the movement of an item that travels in a straight line and maintains a constant speed along that line while traversing equal distances in similar amounts of time, regardless of the length of the time. If a body is moving rectilinearly and the motion is steady, then the body's acceleration must be zero.

questions.q: Which of the following are food preservatives?
options: Salt, sodium nitrite, spices and vinegar
Formic acid, vinegar and methyl alcohol
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Salt, sodium nitrite, spices and vinegar.

Key Points

• Food preservation techniques include those that increase food's resistance to microbial growth and slow fat oxidation.

• Decomposition and rancidification are slowed down as a result.

• Food preservatives include salt, sodium nitrite, spices, and vinegar.

• Processes that prevent the aesthetic deterioration of food, such as the enzymatic browning reaction that occurs when apples are chopped during food preparation, may also be included in food preservation.

• Food preservation helps to reduce food waste, which is a crucial step in lowering production costs, boosting the effectiveness of food systems, enhancing food security and nutrition, and promoting environmental sustainability.

Additional Information

• It has been demonstrated that some traditional food preservation techniques use less energy and leave a smaller carbon footprint than more contemporary techniques.

• It is known that several food preservation techniques produce carcinogens.

• Meat that has been salted, cured, fermented, or smoked is considered processed meat by the World Health Organization's International Agency for Research on Cancer to be "carcinogenic to humans" in 2015.

questions.q: Which of the following line separates Pakistan and Afghanistan?

• The Durand Line is a boundary between Afghanistan and British India that runs through tribal regions in the Hindu Kush and was established in 1893 to delineate their separate spheres of influence.

• Subsequently, it served to delineate the Pakistani-Afghanistan border.

• The Afghanistan-Pakistan border, a 2,670-kilometer (1,660 mi) international land border between Afghanistan and Pakistan in South Asia, is defined by the Durand Line.

• The eastern end reaches China's border, while the western end reaches Iran's border.

Additional Information

• The Radcliffe Line served as the dividing line between the areas of British India's Punjab and Bengal provinces that were in India and Pakistan.

• At the conclusion of the Shimla Conference, Tibet and Great Britain negotiated the McMahon Line, the border between Tibet and Assam in British India (October 1913–July 1914).

• Sir Henry McMahon, the leading British negotiator, is honoured with the moniker McMahon Line.

questions.q:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

Luckily, the machinery was not used by them.
options: Luckily, they had not used the machinery.
Luckily, they did not use the machinery.
Luckily, they have not used the machinery.
Luckily, I did not used the machinery.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Luckily, they did not use the machinery.'

Key Point

• Rules to be followed while converting active voice from passive voice :

• Identify the Subject, Verb, and Object in the passive sentence to convert to active voice.

• Interchange the object and subject with each other i.e. subject of the passive sentence becomes the object in an active sentence.

• The past participle (V3) forms in a passive sentence i.e. preceded by (by, with, to, etc) are changed to the base verb in the active sentence.

• 'Them' will be changed to 'they' as it will become the subject of the active voice.

• Structure:

• Passive Voice - Object + was/were + not + V3 + by + Subject.

• Active Voice - Subject + did/do + not + V1 + Object.

• Following the above-mentioned rules, the right active sentence: Luckily, they did not use the machinery.
